architecture.shell: Windows x64 EXE contains UI/backend shell only; textbook payload external.

architecture.portable: Place content ZIP beside EXE as Book-Content.zip for automatic detection, or install through the content-package UI.
architecture.updates: Future textbook updates can replace the verified content package without rebuilding the EXE.
architecture.personal_state: Notes/bookmarks/cards/positions/user font remain outside content packages.

reading_experience.fullscreen: F11/button -> Fullscreen API with immersive fallback; Esc exits.
reading_experience.immersive: M hides reading chrome with recovery HUD.
reading_experience.typography: Local Windows ShuSong-first; body 400; font-synthesis none; fallback Song/serif; no commercial font redistributed.
reading_experience.clean_reading: Source/OCR/provenance interruptions hidden from ordinary flow and preserved in audit layer.
reading_experience.mode_flow: 预习→学习→复习→刷题; review active recall; practice answers folded per question.
